name: kit-pointer
about: LumaKit pointer (lumakit.md 2.22, lumakit-modules.md row 12). kit-pointer on EggStarGalaxy with the pointer held below the player (0.5, 0.8): at the middle it is on the player, whose drawn depth is where the shooter searches, while world() goes through to the map behind. world_point: world() finds the map under the pointer, its normal unit length. throw_coins_cost: with set_throw(Coins(1)) B throws the mod's shot once and takes one coin, star bits untouched. out_of_coins: with no coins B throws nothing and the game's CS_NO_SPIECE sound plays. grab: a Kuribo made under the pointer; A calls the grab function with it. gyro_and_refusal: source(pad 0, Infrared) taken; source(pad 0, Gyro) refused on the harness's pad (no motion device), the log naming it. mod_off: the mod taken out. WAITING: kit.projectile (FB, next); LUMA_OUT on MR::calcWorldRayDirectionFromScreen and MR::getFirstPolyNormalOnLineToMap, MR::payCoin (F); input.Pad, input.PointerSource, input.pointer_source (H, input 1.x after net.kit); std make/MakePlace (K).
